title: Graph Transductive Sharpening: Leveraging Unlabeled Predictions in Node Classification
abstract: arXiv:2605.20248v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: In the transductive setting, where the full graph is observed but node labels are only partially available, progress in semi-supervised node classification has largely focused on architectural innovation. In this paper, we revisit an orthogonal axis: the training objective. We start from a simple observation: transductive models produce predictions for every node during training, including nodes without labels. These unlabeled-node predictions may contain useful training signal, but standard supervised objectives discard them because no ground-truth labels are available. Inspired by the decomposition of cross-entropy into a label-dependent alignment term and a label-independent entropy term, we propose prediction confidence as a natural way to extract this signal in the absence of labels. This motivates Transductive Sharpening (TS): a loss-level modification that minimizes prediction entropy on unlabeled nodes while counterbalancing

translated_title: 图直推锐化：在节点分类中利用未标注节点的预测
translated_abstract: 在直推式设置中，虽然可以观察到完整的图结构，但节点标签只有部分可用，半监督节点分类的进展很大程度上集中在架构创新上。在本文中，我们重新审视了一个与之正交的方向：训练目标。我们从一个简单的观察出发：直推式模型在训练过程中会对每个节点都产生预测，包括那些没有标签的节点。这些未标注节点的预测可能包含有用的训练信号，但由于缺乏真实标签，标准的监督目标会将它们丢弃。受交叉熵可分解为标签相关对齐项与标签无关熵项的启发，我们提出将预测置信度作为在缺乏标签情况下提取这一信号的自然方式。由此我们提出直推锐化：一种损失层面的修改方法，它在最小化未标注节点预测熵的同时进行平衡……
tldr: 该论文提出直推锐化（TS）这一损失层面的修改方法，通过最小化未标注节点的预测熵来提取直推式模型对未标注节点预测中蕴含的训练信号，从而改进半监督节点分类。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes Transductive Sharpening (TS), a loss-level modification that extracts the useful training signal contained in unlabeled-node predictions by minimizing prediction entropy on unlabeled nodes, thereby improving semi-supervised node classification.
